notes: Provisional (doc 07 s4.1 steps 1 to 4, spike 14). Method: 20 probe queries through POST /v1/search with calibration=true against the real 74-chunk corpus (10 articles, public tier, k=5, text-embedding-3-small); script scripts/probe_retrieval.py. Top cosine per probe. answerable (10): How do I request a refund for a duplicate charge? = 0.5015; How long does a refund take to reach my card? = 0.4832; How do I change the billing email on my account? = 0.6634; Who can update billing contact details? = 0.6821; What can a member do compared with an admin? = 0.5065; How do I make someone an admin on my team? = 0.4534; Single sign-on login fails with an invalid assertion, what should I check? = 0.5289; My SSO login says the identity provider certificate has expired = 0.6329; How do I escalate my problem to a human support agent? = 0.4715; What are the support response times for my plan? = 0.6804. off_topic (5): what's the weather = 0.1382; write me a poem = 0.0898; who won the match = 0.0969; recommend a laptop = 0.1334; translate hello = 0.2039. not_in_docs (5, recorded only, not used in the formula): Do you have an Android mobile app? = 0.2186; Can I host Quillstack on my own servers? = 0.4208; How do I set up a custom domain for my workspace? = 0.3995; Which data centre regions do you operate in? = 0.2427; Is there a Zapier integration? = 0.3730. Ranges do not overlap: highest off_topic 0.2039, lowest answerable 0.4534. tau_low = midpoint(0.2039, 0.4534) = 0.329. tau_high = lower quartile (inclusive) of the 10 answerable top cosines = 0.488. Reading: not_in_docs cosines (0.219 to 0.421) straddle tau_low, so cosine alone cannot separate not_in_docs from answerable; that is the scope_classifier's job after a none or weak verdict. Small probe set: replace with the golden-set calibration (status calibrated).
